shortDescription: Nutanix NASDAQ:NTNX announced on Thursday that Tarkan Maner has decided to step down as president and chief commercial officer, effective October 2, 2026.Following his departure, CEO Rajiv Ramaswami will oversee the company’s sales, marketing, and customer experience organizations, the firm said in…

children: announced on Thursday that Tarkan Maner has decided to step down as president and chief commercial officer, effective October 2, 2026.
Following his departure, CEO Rajiv Ramaswami will oversee the company’s sales, marketing, and customer experience organizations, the firm said in its SEC filing.
Nutanix said it is discussing a potential senior advisor arrangement with Maner, under which he would provide transition and strategic advisory services.

title: Nutanix's CCO Tarkan Maner to step down
